name: Shirmani Social App Hybrid MVP
truth_boundary: No fabricated people, accounts, followers, views, likes, payments, income or employment.
Local demo records are explicitly non-production and do not represent real users.
AI assistance, if added later, must not be treated as proof of identity, transaction or personal experience.
Online mode requires a separately deployed trusted API, database, HTTPS and operational security controls.
A failed online write falls back to local storage and is not represented as an online transaction.
